title: Induction Machine Scalar Control
text: Induction Machine V/f 控制，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；{Rated electrical frequency (Hz)} 指定频率、{Rated voltage (V)} 指定电压、{Minimum voltage (V)} 指定电压、{Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间，按实例取值。

params.name: Rated voltage (V)
params.values: 电压 550 (default) | positive and greater than the value of the Minimum voltage (V) parameter

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | positive scalar
